page_title: SEV 1-2 VIL | Sevilla v Villarreal 23/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+6' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+5' 1 - 2 Goal! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
90+2' Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Diego Conde makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
90+1' Half-chance! Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) plays a pass into the box, but Diego Conde reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
90' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
88' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
87' The attendance is 34004.
86' The resulting corner from Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
86' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Lucas Ocampos will be replaced by Jesus Navas (Sevilla).
86' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
85' Raul Albiol comes onto the pitch because Eric Bailly (Villarreal) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
84' Eric Bailly (Villarreal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
84' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
82' Looks like Alex Baena (Villarreal) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Isaac Romero and he is replaced by Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla).
77' Here is a change. Kike Salas is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Marcao (Sevilla).
75' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
74' Kike Salas (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
73' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Santi Comesana.
73' Substitution. Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) in, Ilias Akhomach out.
71' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta is forced to make a change. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is unable to continue due to injury, Chidera Ejuke comes on.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dodi Lukebakio departs the field of play to be replaced by Djibril Sow (Sevilla).
71' Celebrations are cut short for Villarreal as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
71' Wait! Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera has indicated he is going to review the Villarreal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
70' Goal! Ilias Akhomach puts a cross into the box and finds Santi Comesana (Villarreal), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the left post. He makes it 1:2.
65' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) replaces Arnaut Danjuma.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Thierno Barry (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch so that Nicolas Pepe can be given a rest.
64' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) takes the free kick from just outside the box and unleashes a fine shot to the roof of the net, but his effort is thwarted by Diego Conde who parries it onto the post.
63' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.
63' Alex Baena (Villarreal) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

62' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots towards the left post, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Diego Conde. What a save!

60' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Diego Conde thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
60' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
58' Flag goes up against Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
55' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 59:41.
52' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.
49' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

49' A lofted cross from Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out for a corner. Villarreal can continue in their attacking effort.
48' A great solo run by Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Orjan Nyland.
46' The whistle blows and Isidro Diaz de Mera starts the second half.
45+9' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' 1 - 1 Goal! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:1.
45+3' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
45+2' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
45+1' Alex Baena (Villarreal) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
45' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
44' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
44' The Sevilla players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
42' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
42' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
41' A quickly taken corner by Sevilla.
41' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Sevilla get a corner.
41' The total number of attempts is 7:2.

37' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Diego Conde has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
36' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
34' Loic Bade (Sevilla) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
34' The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.

34' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Sevilla force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
30' The linesman signals that Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
28' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
27' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) picks up an injury.
25' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Flag up against Isaac Romero (Sevilla). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
20' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
18' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

18' A loose ball is pounced on by Saul Niguez (Sevilla) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Diego Conde is alert and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
16' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Diego Conde was alert and made a comfortable save.
14' The referee signals a corner kick to Sevilla.
14' An attempted cross from Saul Niguez (Sevilla) is cleared. Good work from Sevilla as they win a corner.
11' The game is interrupted. Pape Gueye (Villarreal) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
10' The goal by Sevilla won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
9' The Sevilla players halt their celebrations as referee Isidro Diaz de Mera makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
8' Goal Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla)! Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) was put through by Isaac Romero and he showed brilliant composure to tuck it home from inside the box. 1:1.
6' Alex Baena (Villarreal) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
5' Orjan Nyland pulls off a great save to deny Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
2' 0 - 1 Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
Villarreal will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Isidro Diaz de Mera.
